Ekaterina Andreevna Kazionova ( Russian : Екатерина Андреевна Казионова ; born 13 January 1999) is a Russian tennis player. Kazionova has career-high WTA rankings of 280 in singles and 310 in doubles. Up to date, she has won three singles titles and eleven doubles tournaments on the ITF Circuit . [ 2 ] Kazionova made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2022 Morocco Open , after receiving a wildcard entry into the doubles tournament, partnering with Yasmine Kabbaj .
